title.romaji: Sousou no Frieren: ●● no Mahou Part 2
title.native: 葬送のフリーレン ～●●の魔法～ 2クール

description:
A second batch of the ●● no Mahou shorts released monthly in the lead up to the TV anime's second season, starting with #12. Posted on the official YouTube account of TOHO animation, Frieren Twitter, and Frieren TikTok account.

Includes:
• Shinchou ga Nobiru Mahou (身長が伸びる魔法), released Apr 2, 2025.
• Onaka-ippai ni Naru Mahou (おなかいっぱいになる魔法), released May 7, 2025.
• Daitai Nan demo Kiru Mahou (大体なんでも切る魔法), released Jun 4, 2025.
• Kousoku de Idou Suru Mahou (高速で移動する魔法), released Jul 2, 2025.
• Karada no Mawari wo Suzushiku Suru Mahou (体のまわりを涼しくする魔法), released Aug 6, 2025.
• Tokui Waza wo Fuujiru Mahou (得意技を封じる魔法), released Sep 3, 2025.
